china_race_dynamics.text:
Last week I gave a speech on the Senate floor on the importance of competing against China and winning the race against China on key emerging technologies: crypto, biotech, and AI. 

Today, the Trump administration took a critical and commonsense step forward by releasing a framework that gives Congress a clear roadmap to capitalize on AI’s potential. AI has enormous positive potential to transform health care, grow our economy, and improve the lives of everyday Americans. This framework gets the big things right: protecting our kids online, protecting our First Amendment rights, establishing a uniform national policy that gives innovators certainty, and recognizing that, to win the AI race with China, we need to continue unleashing American energy dominance.
